# opnsense_monit_alert (Data Source)

Retrieves a Monit alert recipient by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_monit_alert" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the alert.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the alert.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alert is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Set of events this alert triggers on.
- `format` (String) Custom message template for the alert email.
- `not_on` (Boolean) Whether the selected events are negated.
- `recipient` (String) Email address alerts are sent to.
- `reminder` (String) Reminder interval, in cycles.
